The MaishaFiti app allows members to develop,
implement and track healthy habits such as steps,
distance, calories burned and active minutes,
enabling further improvement of health. It also
provides access to medical services through
tele-consultation, drug delivery and the option
of joining various communities that fit in the
member’s needs. Success and results are pegged
on enrolment and participation and incentives,
discounts or prizes are offered to members
consistently meeting their wellness goals.

3,500 new members
have signed up
to-date
